title: Great App
body: It is a fantastic app designed to support individuals with ADHD, offering various tools and resources to help manage symptoms and improve focus. The interface is intuitive and user-friendly, making it easy to navigate through the different features. However, there is a notable issue with the audio playback: when the phone screen turns off, the audio stops playing. This can be particularly disruptive during activities such as meditation, where continuous audio is crucial. Addressing this issue would significantly enhance the user experience. Despite this drawback, Univi remains a valuable app for ADHD support.
author: fivxdtjjxsikb
